dramas.title: Queen of Tears
dramas.synopsis: The queen of department stores and her small-town lawyer husband weather a marital crisis until love miraculously begins to rekindle.
dramas.featured_quote: When love feels like memory, fighting for it becomes life itself.

dramas.title: Twinkling Watermelon
dramas.synopsis: A CODA high school student travels back in time to 1995, bonding with his teenage father and forming a rock band called Watermelon Sugar.
dramas.featured_quote: Viva la vida — shining even in the silence.

dramas.title: Hidden Love
dramas.synopsis: Sang Zhi falls in love with Duan Jiaxu, the boy who often visits her home to play games in her older brother's room. Years later, their secret crushes cross paths as adults.
dramas.featured_quote: The paper stars in the jar keep the wishes I was too shy to say out loud.

dramas.title: Moving
dramas.synopsis: Children with hidden superhuman abilities and their parents who harbor painful secrets from the past confront an impending dangerous conspiracy.
dramas.featured_quote: Compassion is a true superpower. Flying is just secondary.

dramas.title: Alice in Borderland
dramas.synopsis: An aimless gamer and his two friends find themselves in a deserted Tokyo, where they are forced to compete in dangerous games to survive.
dramas.featured_quote: To survive the arena, you must first remember what you are living for.

dramas.title: Someday or One Day
dramas.synopsis: Grieving her late lover, a woman listens to an old cassette tape that transports her back to 1998 into the body of a high school girl who resembles her.
dramas.featured_quote: Only if you want to see me, our meeting will be meaningful.

dramas.title: Hospital Playlist
dramas.synopsis: Stories of five doctors who have been best friends since medical school in 1999 as they navigate life, hospital wards, and their after-work garage band.
dramas.featured_quote: Life is just a collection of warm meals shared with friends.

dramas.title: Love Between Fairy and Devil
dramas.synopsis: A gentle flower fairy accidentally frees the formidable Moon Supreme, setting off an epic cosmic destiny entwined with soul-swapping and unyielding affection.
dramas.featured_quote: Even if heaven commands me to eliminate you, I would conquer heaven.

journals.author: MinJoo_Chronicles
journals.title: Episode 14 Breakdown: The bittersweet weight of Hae-in's recorded memory
journals.excerpt: I watched the Germany scene three times at 2 AM. The way Baek Hyun-woo clutches the recorder in the snow broke me completely. It reminded me that love is not about having an easy life...

journals.author: RetroEunGyeol
journals.title: Why this drama changed my relationship with my dad
journals.excerpt: Growing up, I never considered who my parents were before they had me. Hearing teenage Ha Yi-chan scream 'Viva la vida' while strumming an acoustic guitar felt like healing an unspoken generational wound...

journals.author: BobaAndDramas
journals.title: Duan Jiaxu's emotional patience: A study on gentle male leads
journals.excerpt: What makes this story special is the respect Duan Jiaxu maintains throughout Sang Zhi's growth. There is no toxic jealousy, only unwavering protection and the sweetest paper star confessions...
